title: ExtractedDoc
description: Per-PDF extraction output. Written once per (sha256, backend) pair. Wire contract between pdfsys-core and pdfsys-parsers.

Backend.title: Backend
Backend.description: Which extraction backend produced a given document. Values are the enum .value strings.

RegionType.title: RegionType
RegionType.description: Block-level content classification for a Segment.

BBox.title: BBox
BBox.description: Normalized bounding box. All coordinates are in [0.0, 1.0]; origin is top-left, y points downward.

Segment.title: Segment
Segment.description: A block-level extracted unit. content semantics depend on type: TEXT=Markdown, TABLE=HTML, FORMULA=LaTeX, IMAGE=path or data URI.

index.description: Zero-based reading-order index within the document.

page_index.description: Zero-based page number this segment was extracted from.

content.description: Extracted content; encoding depends on type.

bbox.description: Normalized bounding box on the page. None when block coordinates are degenerate (e.g., zero-size or out-of-page-bounds).

source_region_id.description: region_id of the upstream LayoutRegion this segment derives from. None for the mupdf backend (which does not consume a LayoutDocument).

ExtractedDoc.title: ExtractedDoc
ExtractedDoc.description: Per-PDF extraction output produced by any backend. The segments tuple is the authoritative record; markdown is a convenience merge.

sha256.description: Hex-encoded SHA-256 of the source PDF bytes.

segments.description: Ordered list of block-level segments in reading order.

markdown.description: Convenience merge: segment contents joined by blank-line separators.

stats.description: Free-form per-run statistics (page_count, ocr_char_count, etc.). Schema is intentionally open.
